title: Chroma: a generative model for protein design
summary: Generate:Biomedicines published the Chroma model in Nature; it designs new proteins with requested biophysical, biological and therapeutic properties. The weights are freely available to academic and nonprofit researchers. The press release gives no experimental figures, and performance claims come from the company.

evidence.tested: The Nature paper reports experimental characterization of 310 designed proteins and crystal structures of two designs matching the predicted structures (backbone RMSD about 1.0 Å); the press release itself describes no experiments and states no limitations.
evidence.unknown: The paper abstract states no limitations; the press release gives no experimental figures and its performance claims come from the company.
evidence.ai_role: A generative model samples protein structures and sequences and can be conditioned on specified properties or functions.
